name: manual_f42cfe
claim: Orphan branch recovery: symptoms = git merge-base HEAD origin/main exit 1; git rebase origin/main produces add/add conflicts on every file. Fix: git fetch origin main && git reset --hard origin/main; manually re-apply ~5 changed files. Prevention: always create feature branches from origin/main.
